necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, which have persisted despite initial management. To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment. This service aligns with diagnosis codes I47.1 and I49.9 to address the clinical need for extended ambulatory assessment.
